name: Darren Lau's X account
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: CertiK Alert tweeted that the X account of Darren Lau, founder of The Daily Ape, has been compromised by hackers. The CertiK security team warns users not to click any links or approve any transactions before control of the account is restored, and to remain vigilant.
